title: CI/CD pipeline with gates that block and a recorded rollback
oneLiner: Eight PR gates feed one required ci-ok check; the demo page starts the gate run, ships a bad image, and redeploys the previous release.

live.firstAction: Click Run the gates and watch each job turn green.
limits: The free instance sleeps after 15 minutes idle and takes about a minute to wake.
The demo page starts one action at a time; the buttons stay disabled while a run is in flight.
A full gate run takes several minutes and spends the repository's Actions minutes.

shots.alt: Terminal transcript of bash scripts/demo.sh on this machine: a healthy release passes five smoke assertions, a deliberately broken release returns 500 on POST /invoices, and rollback restores the previous release and passes smoke again.
Rollback timeline read from deploy.log: deploy.start, health.ok, smoke.fail, rollback.start, rollback.health.ok and rollback.smoke.ok, with elapsed seconds for the broken release.
Terminal transcript of bash scripts/verify.sh: ESLint and tsc --noEmit pass, nine integration tests pass against PostgreSQL 16, and the final line is verify: ok.

Trivy report for the locally built invoice-api:slim image at CRITICAL and HIGH severity with ignore-unfixed: zero findings and exit code 0, beside the trivy job settings read from .github/workflows/pr.yml.

invariants.claim: Unauthenticated POST /invoices is rejected with 401; an authenticated request returns 201 with a UUID id
GET /ready reports 503 pending_migrations when a migration is unapplied, and 200 when database and migrations are okay
An unknown invoice id returns 404 not_found with no stack trace in the body

limits: A full run spends the repository's Actions minutes.
The Actions PostgreSQL service is configured separately from local PostgreSQL 16.
Rollback returns one release and is built for expand/contract migrations.
